items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)

items.effect: approximated: its text styles are the base of the notes text; the notes page layout (slide image, header, footer, date, page number placeholders and the master's own theme) is not kept
items.label: notes master(s)

items.effect: approximated: the notes text and its paragraph and character formatting are kept in the notes; the fonts and styles of the notes master apply only where the notes do not state their own, and the editor may draw a style slightly differently
items.label: slide(s) whose speaker notes carry formatting (bold, italic, underline, bullets or numbering)
